idea.summary: Air-gap alarm after the soil cracks
idea.description: In clay soils a dry spell opens cracks around the probe and readings drop for no real reason. Proposal: compare the 10 cm and 30 cm electrodes; when their usual coherence breaks after a run of dry days, flag a possible air gap instead of reporting a dry soil. Not built. No data collected yet.
idea.step: Track the rolling correlation between the 10 cm and 30 cm readings.
After 5 or more dry days, if the correlation falls below 0.3, flag "possible air gap" to the grower.

idea.summary: Battery-aware exception reporting over the radio
idea.description: Saves airtime and battery. Built into firmware 3.2 and shipping.
idea.step: Send a reading over LoRa only when moisture has changed by more than 1 % VWC since the last report.
Always send one heartbeat a day so the gateway knows the probe is alive.
When the solar battery is under 30% charge, sample every 60 minutes instead of every 15.
idea.comment: I think this is our strongest one, nobody combines these.

idea.description: The app tells growers when to irrigate. Live since May 2026.
idea.step: Hold back the irrigate-now advice when the forecast gives more than 60% chance of rain in the next 24 hours.
Deliver the advice only inside the delivery window the grower chose in the app.
